title: Creators talking to the Ivy device

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device with the hook being that the ideas are connected into something like
Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube, if you can find it.

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Several creators talk to the device
cards.gist: A video selling the Ivy product itself by filming several creators speaking their ideas into the device, hooked on how those ideas get connected together.

cards.title: Short, seamless product to output cut
cards.gist: Keep the video short, pass the device between different hands and people, and make the flow from product to AI to output to finished video feel seamless and fun.

loose_ends.text: Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube, if you can find it.
